question: Does a population classifier improve on a fresh, autonomously selected incumbent specifically for rows whose complete recurring attribute block is absent from training?
inputs: Development uses the two already registered held-profile folds 0 and 3 on the released training packet. No course validation, test, H2, LLM calls or dataset-specific feature names. These two decisions and all external predictions are sealed before their outcomes are graded. Check regular five-fold coverage from features only.
method: Infer the recurring block from the fitting features. On unseen blocks only, allow a population tree using the raw columns, up to three train-supported field interactions, a varying-context token and optional cross-fitted aligned categorical fields. Do not include an identity token for the entire recurrent block or its intersections. For supervised alignment, keep whole training profiles together in three folds; give each row weight proportional to inverse square root of its profile frequency, normalized and clipped to [0.35, 3] before rescaling. One default depth-six, 600-iteration CatBoost per fit. On recognized profiles always reproduce the incumbent.
feedback: Use folds 0 and 3 of five inner stratified profile-group folds with seed 39013. On each, retrain the exact component recipe/real seeds of the outer frozen agent on fitting rows; both systems exclude all held profiles from fitting. On first inner holdout choose 0, 1/4, 1/2 or full share by most correct then smallest Brier then smallest share. The chosen nonzero share must match or beat control on both panels, gain at least 0.20 percentage points pooled and have nonincreasing pooled Brier. Otherwise retain the incumbent. Automatically mask all corrections for query profiles already in fitting data or if no block is discoverable.
controls: Report the policy, incumbent, a fixed quarter blend and a population-only prediction restricted to novel rows. Restore the full population tree from disk in a second process and compare deployment probabilities/labels before grading. Previous cold solves are reused only for their legitimate incumbent and feature-only queries. At most 64 classifier units per treatment including the parent run and all added control and population fits.
advancement: A gain strictly above zero in each of the two held-profile folds and at least 0.30 percentage points pooled qualifies the research policy to be tested on two further held-profile folds (1 and 2). This stress test cannot authorize another course-validation score. Results are grouped by inferred profiles, which do not establish individual identity.
